text: Provincial legislation permits Toronto Public Health to undertake enforcement against dust that causes a health hazard. Toronto Building is responsible for nuisance dust, or dust that is not considered a health hazard. When construction or demolition blankets neighbourhoods with nuisance dust, Toronto Building’s strongest means of recourse is currently to give developers a stern request to implement dust control measures. As many of my constituents affected by recent construction and demolition will attest, that is unacceptable. Nuisance causes shortness of breath, eye irritation, and, especially for asthmatic residents, potentially life-threatening long-term respiratory issues. Moreover, it inconveniences property owners with increased cleaning and filter replacement costs.
